changes.title: Session Encounters: who you keep meeting in battle

current.changeLog:
CURRENT VERSION CHANGES

Statistics filters: Today, 3 days, 7 days, All time, Last 30 and Last 50 battles
Reset statistics button with automatic backup
Compact after-battle notification instead of a long player list
Full-screen statistics window with close button
Fixed double counting after reconnecting to a battle
Battle results are requested again until they are available

previous.changeLog:
- Fixed: playlist badges no longer show on tanks with a similar name (T-34 badge on T-34-85)
- Fixed: settings page no longer shows "no answer from the game" debug message

current.changeLog:
- Stricter badge matching: a badge shows only on the exact vehicle name. Similar names no longer get each other's badge (SU-152 vs ISU-152).
- Settings page reliability: no lost answers when you click fast, and none after reloading the page.
-Badge settings are kept when the game loses its connection.

previous.changeLog: - Fixed: settings page no longer shows "no answer from the game" debug message

current.changeLog: - Settings page reliability: no lost answers when you click fast, and none after reloading the page. Your players, tags and settings are kept.
Fixed errors in the Frontline Hangar
